backend: Distinct typed world, all three wrapper shapes, actual typed integer SAP/PairManager, no Guest/register interpreter/native fallback in implementation.
oracle_pin: oracle_native.h held-FD SHA256 and dlopen same file, ELF32 actual MSVC methods/public wrappers.
corpus: 16 from-scratch native and typed worlds,192steps each; scales1/30; all circle/rectangle/triangle pairs, static floor and dynamic pieces, gravity, contact births/loss, stable DFS/edge order, velocity setter, origin teleport, deferred deletion, slot reuse/replacement. Four scenes add partial world-bound clamping and complete exits/freezing, including frozen-origin semantics.
compared: Bitwise initialized body fields, flags, COM/current/prior transforms, independent cached matrices, physical velocities/forces/damping/mass/inertia/sleep; active shape vertices/normals/core/localOBB, proxy/material/filter data; canonical body/contact-list and contact-edge order; all active manifold points/impulses/IDs. Broadphase live endpoint/proxy/query fields, pair keys/status/next/normalized token order, entire hash table, free lists, counters/timestamps/world bounds/quantization.
not_compared: Allocation addresses, custom trace IDs, padding, unused native shape/manifold slots, free-slot opaque userData and unused bounds/query/pairbuffer tails. These are not consumed by future physical execution. Full typed snapshot state is preserved within its own backend.
runtime_path: ScenePipelineState::step cleans deferred contacts/bodies, collides, preserves DFS islands, builds/solves constraints, integrates/synchronizes, handles native InRange/Freeze, sleeps and commits SAP. Hot path walks live intrusive lists; maxpool validation/hash and fixed-pair guard are absent.
limits: This receipt is a host full-scene hidden-state gate; GPU dynamic scene qualification and throughput are separate.
Irisu wrapper construction domain: one shape per body, no joints. Numeric domain follows shared strict PC53 helpers and fails closed outside admission.
Historical fixed-circle GPU512frames+memcheck, all-shape collision/solver/factory/SAP GPU component gates and the full-game record are separately tracked; this gate does not replace them.
